occasions.lede: Whether it's a big occasion or simply the wish to make someone happy, every moment deserves to be lived differently. At Yurday, no occasion is needed to imagine an entirely bespoke day, designed in the image of the person you wish to give it to. Because everyone deserves an experience that feels like them.
occasions.moreLabel: And so many other moments to celebrate
occasions.tagline: There is no wrong occasion to give a day to someone you love.

moments.h2: One moment, among every step of their day
moments.lede: This is only a glimpse: every day is designed as a whole, from morning to night.
moments.cta: Want a day like this one? Tell us about yours.

montgolfiere-fete-des-meres.title: Grégoire, a hot air balloon flight for Mother's Day
montgolfiere-fete-des-meres.story: He wanted to give his mother a moment that belonged to just the two of them, away from everyday life. Among all the steps we designed for that day, this one was the high point: a hot air balloon chartered just for them, drifting above the golden countryside at sunset.

degustation-vin.title: Aymeric, a wine tasting in a secret cellar for his father's 75th birthday
degustation-vin.story: He wanted to give his father a moment that belonged to just the two of them, away from the usual family dinners. We built an entire day around that idea, and at its heart, a century-old cellar in Paris, a sommelier at their side and the finest vintages to discover together.

croisiere-seine.title: Thibault, a dinner cruise on the Seine for their tenth year together
croisiere-seine.story: He wanted to mark ten years together with a whole day that felt like them. Among the steps we strung together for them, this one stayed the most memorable: a private cruise on the Seine, roses and champagne on the table, the illuminated Eiffel Tower as their only witness.

opera-chauffeur.title: Victoire, an evening at the Opéra with a private driver to surprise her husband
opera-chauffeur.story: She wanted to give him a day where all he had to do was be carried from one moment to the next. We built it for him step by step, up to this high point: a dinner followed by an evening at the Opéra Garnier, private car and driver from departure to return.

caleche-saint-valentin.title: Amaury, a horse-drawn carriage ride through Paris for their Valentine's Day
caleche-saint-valentin.story: He wanted to give them a Valentine's Day suspended in time, far from traffic and phones. We planned it step by step, and along the way, a vintage carriage, coachman in a top hat, for a tour of Paris at a horse's pace all the way to the foot of the Eiffel Tower.

process.lede: Four steps, from the first conversation to the day itself.

steps.title: Tell us about them
steps.body: Who the day is for, the date in mind, what moves them, what they can't stand, a memory that matters: every detail helps us compose a day that truly feels like them.

steps.title: We envision the day
steps.body: We come back to you with the day fully imagined: an hour-by-hour itinerary and a clear presentation of the pricing.

steps.title: You approve
steps.body: Before final approval, we refine every detail with you, live, until it's exactly what you pictured.

steps.title: We orchestrate everything
steps.body: On the day itself, we take care of the entire experience: all you have to do is live the moment.

paragraphs: We knew exactly who we wanted to bring a moment of happiness to, heads full of ideas, without yet knowing how to turn that wish into a day worthy of it.
Everywhere, the same ready-made packages, the same boxes to tick.
So we imagined it all ourselves: the itinerary, the venues, every surprise, down to inviting their loved ones to play a part in the day too.
Watching their surprise, their emotion, one thing became clear: we hadn't just created an activity. A whole story to live.
Today, the idea hasn't changed one bit.
You entrust us with the person, the occasion, your budget.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every day is different, so every budget is too. We always build the day around the starting budget you give us, never the other way around.

items.question: How far in advance should I contact you?
items.answer: Once we're in touch, allow about 2 weeks from when we send our questionnaire for the day to be ready. We can move faster for urgent projects, tell us your timeline and we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

items.question: Where do you operate?
items.answer: We currently operate in Paris and its surrounding area (Île-de-France). Tell us where you are and we'll quickly confirm if it's possible.

items.question: What if we're a group (bachelor/bachelorette party)?
items.answer: No problem: we always separate the person being celebrated from the group living the day, so the logistics (meals, transport, activities) are costed accurately, either per head or as a flat rate, whichever makes sense.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: You pay nothing until you've validated the program and the price. Payment only happens once everything works for you.

items.question: How do you keep it a surprise for the person?
items.answer: We build the whole logistics so they never suspect a thing: appointments presented as something else, loved ones briefed, timing worked out to the minute. You tell us what they already know, we handle the rest.

anniversaire.intro: Tell us about the birthday you have in mind for your loved one, and we'll imagine their perfect day, from the first surprise to the very last moment.
anniversaire.story: Yurday was actually born from a birthday: a wish to do things properly for someone we love, rather than settling for a gift unwrapped in ten seconds. Since then, we apply the same method to every birthday entrusted to us: we start from the person, never from a catalogue.

cta.title: Ready to write their story?
cta.text: Tell us who you want to spoil, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 48 hours.

demande-en-mariage.intro: Tell us how you picture your marriage proposal, and we'll take care of creating the setting, the timing and the surprise, without them suspecting a thing.
demande-en-mariage.story: A marriage proposal only happens once. That's why we take the time to build everything with you, from the first message to the big day: the location, the timing, the staging, and all the little details that will make this moment exactly the one you imagined.

cta.title: Ready to create this moment?
cta.text: Tell us your story and how you picture it, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 48 hours.

saint-valentin.intro: Tell us what you'd like to give the person who matters for Valentine's Day, and we'll design a bespoke day, far from the classic candlelit dinner.
saint-valentin.story: Valentine's Day often falls into the same rituals: a restaurant, flowers, a bit of last-minute rush. We'd rather start from who you love and what truly matters to them, to build a moment that's genuinely out of the ordinary, just for the two of you.

cta.title: Ready to go off the beaten path?
cta.text: Tell us who you'd like to surprise, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 48 hours.

evg-evjf.intro: Tell us about the bachelor or bachelorette party you have in mind, and we'll take care of organising an unforgettable day for the whole crew, logistics included.
evg-evjf.story: A great bachelor or bachelorette party means a group that enjoys itself from start to finish, with no one having to manage bookings or scheduling. We take care of all the coordination with the crew, so the only thing you have to do is have fun.

fete-des-meres.intro: Tell us what you'd like to give your mum for Mother's Day, and we'll imagine her perfect day, filled with everything she loves.
fete-des-meres.story: We know how hard it can be to find the right way to thank your mum, beyond flowers grabbed at the supermarket the night before. Tell us who she is and what she loves, and we'll build a day around her that truly feels like her.
